title: Giftlift Items
description: This is a texture pack for the boatlabs gamemode "giftlift"
body: This texture pack is not required to play the boatlabs gamemode "Giftlift." It does have some textures to make the items omega fancy. However if you would like to not use some textures, feel free to unzip the file and delete the stuff you don't like! TL;DR A fancy QOL texturepack
